meta_description:
764K likes, 7,892 comments - brunomars on October 2, 2026: "Right after performing 3 sold out stadium shows, back-to-back with no days off, and shooting her own music video, she was gracious enough to be the star in mine. Thank you @Karolg 🩵

Watching you work has been so inspiring. For those that don’t know this beautiful woman works so hard and loves her fans so much. She calls me and tells me how blessed we both are and reminds me to never forget that. I’m honored to say we made music together, performed together and now starred in a high drama telenovela together. 🥰

The world needs your light and your voice Carolina. Thank you for being my Juliet in this music video. 

This is a special song to me and I hope this video inspires someone to love with everything they’ve got! Fellas this is your cue to grab your lady and dance with her. Sincerely, The Romantic 🌹 #dancewithme".
